defs.def: having the job or duty of doing sth or taking care of sb/sth, so that you may be blamed if sth goes wrong 有责任；负责；承担义务

ex.s: Campbell’s point is to wake up those responsible for AI—the technology companies and world leaders—so they are on the same page as all the experts currently developing it.
ex.t: 坎贝尔的目的是唤醒那些对人工智能负责的人——科技公司和世界领导人——让他们与目前开发人工智能的所有专家达成共识。

ex.s: “As a main promoter of the International Tea Day, the birthplace of tea and the ___44___ (large) tea-producing country, China has a ___45___ (responsible)to work with other countries to promote the healthy development of the tea industry.
ex.t: 作为国际茶日的主要推动者、茶的故乡和____44____（large 最大）产茶国，中国有____45____（responsible 责任）与其他国家合作，促进茶产业的健康发展。

ex.s: Firstly, doing housework was helpful for us to be a responsible person.
ex.t: 首先，做家务有助于我们成为一个负责任的人。
她是一位负责任的祖母。

ex.s: To be sure, more than half of teens still engage in these activities, but the ___44___ have slimmed considerably, Between 1976 and 1979, 86 percent of high school seniors had gone on a date; between 2010 and 2015 only 63 percent People say, Oh, it's because teenagers are more responsible, or more lazy, or more boring, “but they're ___45___ the larger trend,” said Jean Twenge, lead author of the study, which drew on seven large time-lag surveys of Americans.
ex.t: 人们说，哦，这是因为青少年更负责任，或者更懒惰，或者更无聊，“但他们____45____（ignore 忽视）了更大的趋势，”该研究的主要作者Jean Twenge说，该研究利用了七项美国大型时间滞后调查。

ex.s: It encourages people to be responsible travellers and involves educating them about the natural world.
ex.t: 它鼓励人们成为负责任的旅行者，并包含对人们进行自然世界教育的内容。

ex.s: The value taught with the Spending jar is that you are responsible for your own happiness.
ex.t: 消费罐所教导的价值观是你要为自己的幸福负责。

ex.s: Spending jar You are responsible for 1___________.

defs.def: being able to be blamed for sth 应受责备；有责任

ex.s: So we still need to prepare food and drinks I'll make a checklist Preparation choose presents for Grandma draw up the guest list on Wednesday make invitations prepare food and drinks on Sunday morning Who's responsible?
ex.t: 所以我们还需要准备食物和饮料，我来制定一个清单：准备给奶奶的礼物，周三列出客人名单，制作邀请函，周日上午准备食物和饮料，谁负责？

defs.def: being the cause of sth 作为原因；成为起因

ex.s: In analyzing his and other research，Dr Prinstein came to another conclusion: Not only is likability related to positive life outcomes, but it is also responsible for those outcomes, too.
ex.t: 在分析他自己和其他人的研究时，普林斯坦博士得出了另一个结论：不仅讨人喜欢与积极的生活结果相关，而且也是这些结果的原因。

ex.s: This remote location is in part responsible for the islands’ diverse wildlife, such as the giant tortoise.
ex.t: 这种偏远的地理位置是这些岛屿拥有多样化野生动物的部分原因，例如巨型陆龟。

defs.def: having to report to sb/sth with authority or in a higher position and explain to them what you have done （向主管者或上级）承担责任
that you can trust and rely on 人或行为举止
needing sb who can be trusted and relied on; involving important duties 责任重大的；需要可靠的人负责的
